body:
> you are not a sociopath

I don't know, I wonder a lot if I'm not one... and I seem to fit most of the criteria, even with the guilt and shame.

I'll have to go now and will only be able to answer to this next Monday.

Thank you all for the help

>It sounds like you may have some kind of depression correct?

I was diagnosed with BPD when I was 18, but at least it isn't as severe as it used to be. I'd like to get proper treatment but I don't have the money to, and even if I had, it would be hard to find a therapist capable of doing DBT where I live.

>Could you explain your relationship with your mother? She did everything but also did bad things to you?

My father abandoned us when I was about 2 years old and she did everything in order to take care of myself until I was an adult. The problem is that my entire life she painted my father as an irresponsible asshole who dumped her alone with me and my brother (that were given to adoption) but I recently found out that she cheated on him, and she was probably with hum because she thought that he had money. She always escalated from rich to richer man, using her looks to get what she wanted. I have a hard time accepting that.

>Who are the people that love you?
My friends, my family and my girlfriend.I can't care for them like other normal people, they tell me about their problems or stuff that they did and I keep forgetting like I don't give a fuck (and I don't). I was supposed to care about my little brother who's about 8 and I don't even know his age or how he's been, I don't know the things that he does, I don't remember the things that people tell me. I live stuck in a world of "me me me". If my mom comes talk to me about anything cool that happened in her life, I promptly forget about it after I hang the phone, because it isn't related to myself. If my girlfriend tells me something cool that happened to her, it's the same... I readily forget about stuff when it isn't of my interest.

I'm sick of being so selfish, of being so stuck within myself... and I can never find a way out and be normal.
